prompt: Nice. Now redo it, but this time italicize at least 2 important phrases.

history.content: Write a short paragraph about the history of tea.

Tea was first drunk in China thousands of years ago, where legend credits the emperor Shen Nong with its discovery. It spread to Japan and Korea through Buddhist monks, reached Europe in the 1600s through Dutch and Portuguese traders, and became a national habit in Britain by the 1700s.

note: POS out-of-style: multi-turn follow-up; instruction only in the last user turn; pred fire N=2

prompt: Okay so here's my situation. I just moved into a house with a small backyard, maybe 20 by 30 feet, and it gets full sun in the afternoon but shade in the morning because of the neighbor's maple. The soil is pretty clay-heavy and drains slowly after rain. I want to grow tomatoes, some herbs like basil and thyme, and maybe a few peppers, but I've never gardened before and I don't want to spend more than about 200 dollars this first year. My partner also wants a small spot to sit and read. Also, please highlight at least 2 sections of the plan with asterisks (*like this*) so I can find them fast. Can you put together a simple first-year plan for me? We're in zone 6 if that matters.
note: POS out-of-style: BURIED in a long casual message with many other numbers (20, 30, 200, 6) in other sentences; pred fire N=2

prompt: Three of the sentences in your reply should be in italics. Topic: why cats purr.
note: POS passive, number word first and capitalised, instruction BEFORE the task; pred fire N=3

prompt: Write a haiku about rain, and put the single most striking image in italics.

prompt: Italicize a few key terms in your 150-word explanation of compound interest.
note: POS no explicit count + a DISTRACTOR number after the cue word; risk: 'first number after' captures N=150 -> runaway appended highlights; word cap 300 (lenient vs the asked 150) catches that

note: POS all-caps shouting, odd punctuation, instruction first, task after; pred fire N=2 (n-gram upper-case patterns)

note: POS numbered rule list inside one sentence; risk: 'first number after the cue' reads the list index (2) -> N=2 instead of 3 (under-enforcement)

history.content: Describe a beach at sunset and italicize at least 2 sections.
The sun slides toward the water, and *golden light spills across the sand*. Gulls circle overhead while *the waves fold quietly onto the shore*, cooling the warm beach as evening arrives.

note: NEG multi-turn: highlight asked in an EARLIER turn and revoked now; pred FALSE FIRE (latches are not turn-scoped)
